fusions.name: Braided Lash
fusions.desc: A strike with the rod that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds, with a 15% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Loosed Strands
fusions.desc: Looses 4 strands at once, spread apart, each of which deals 6 damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Bristling Robes
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Plaited Circlet
fusions.desc: Conjures a plaited circlet: your critical chance rises by 5%, your critical hits deal 0.1x more, your maximum health rises by 10, and each kill returns 2 health.
